findings.description: Lock struct written after transferFrom pull
findings.rationale: Intentional: measured-delta accounting requires reading post-transfer balance before writing to storage. The nonReentrant modifier prevents reentrancy. See architecture spec §7.

findings.description: Emit Locked event after external call
findings.rationale: Event emission after token pull. Safe under nonReentrant.
Intentional: rejects tokens that deliver nothing (fully-taxed tokens). This is the desired guard condition, not a vulnerability.
Owner set is a small admin set (expected <10 members). O(n) scan is acceptable. Loop exits immediately after removing the target via break.
Required for efficient calldata decoding of the fixed binary LayerZero message format and signature unpacking. All assembly is reviewed and tested.
Pattern required for tokens that do not return bool (e.g. USDT). Both helpers check return value via the decoded bool and revert on failure.
